subject: [PATCH v2 1/4] selftests: cover kernfs file handles and same-parent rename

2026-09-05.patch_summary: This patch adds three tests to the kernfs selftest suite: decoding a file handle, decoding while the node is being removed, and looking up a name while an interface is renamed. Additionally, it includes two small fixes: counting only symlinks in ns_tag_isolates_class_net and skipping mkdtemp() failures instead of aborting.
